bias.en: Breakdown · lost every average, under the September lows
bias.zh: 破位下行 · 跌破所有均线，跌至 9 月低点下方

read.en: Tesla fell 10.8% on Nov 5 to $343.69, trading $338.15–374.23 on heavy volume. It is now below every average: the falling 5-day ($386.2), 200-day ($384.3) and 100-day ($367.3) and the rising 10-day ($391.0) and 30-day ($376.9). MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 5, still above zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 ($413.46), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: 特斯拉 11月5日下跌 10.8%，收于 $343.69，盘中区间 $338.15–374.23，成交量明显放大。股价现已位于所有均线下方：下行的 5 日（$386.2）、200 日（$384.3）和 100 日均线（$367.3），以及上行的 10 日（$391.0）和 30 日均线（$376.9）。MACD 于 11月5日下穿信号线，仍在零轴上方；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（$413.46），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The drop broke the 200-day, the $375.5–378 and $368 supports and closed under the $345.9–349.3 September–October lows, all now resistance. Resistance is $345.9–349.3, then $367.3–368.1 (100-day, Oct 19 close) and $384.3–388 (200-day, $388 cap). Support is $337.2–338.2 (Apr 7 and Nov 5 lows), then $325.2–331.1 (August lows) and $315.5. A close above $349.3 would target $367–368; below $337.2, $325–331.
